0022600111.text: The Golden State Warriors (0-1, 3rd in the Pacific, 13th in the West) visit the Phoenix Suns (0-1, 5th in the Pacific, 15th in the West), with both teams still looking for their first win of the 2026-27 season. The Warriors are missing Charles Bassey (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee surgery), while the Suns are without Mark Williams (shoulder surgery) and have Luke Kennard (knee strain) and Oso Ighodaro (oblique strain) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Warriors won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 101-97 victory in Phoenix on February 5, 2026.
